definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.description: Determine whether one complete static plan can satisfy every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted scenario. Compare feasible plans only after whole-plan execution feasibility is established.

authoring.guidance:
What must be completed, for whom, and within which accepted limits?
Which objects, quantities, revisions and locations are covered?
Which factual records and admitted states are we relying on?
Which complete choices may the planner make?
Which activities, dependencies, calendars and capacities must the same plan respect?
Which scoped permissions must cover each required operation?
Which joint operating scenarios must this commitment withstand?
Which obligations are mandatory, and how will passing complete plans be compared?
Module authors supply these declarations and domain vocabulary. Case workers supply only values allowed by the frozen module. Facts, scenarios and operating permission must never be inferred from a preferred plan.

definition.title: Complete a commitment
definition.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

caseDerivation: All case parameters and keyed input rows use the frozen module.inputs types, units, bounds, keys and references; no missing-value defaults or coercion are inferred.
Finite choices draw only from input arrays, input table columns or fixed literal domains; the same assignment applies to every scenario.
The scenarioDomain table explicitly lists admitted joint scenarios; an empty table is an inconsistent basis rather than vacuous feasibility.
Activity graphs, constraints, mandatory obligations, resource mappings, financial mode and preference remain frozen module declarations.
Provenance describes accepted factual sources; identifying a source does not authenticate it or infer readiness.
schema.description: Installed closed typed declaration and case-admission validators; this descriptor is not a complete JSON Schema. Publication checks admission, not computed feasibility.

structuralSlots.description: Declare one time origin, common time and money units, and additional numeric units.
Declare required typed parameters and keyed relations.
Declare finite static controls from input-only domains.
Bind the input relation containing explicit joint scenarios.
Bind typed acyclic consequences using the installed expression language.
Declare static activity actors, timing and renewable resource demands.
Map resource capacities and existing bookings.
Name and explain every mandatory commitment obligation.
Bind predicates and shared resource-capacity checks to obligations.
Declare nonrefundable charges and optional timed refundable holds.
Optionally require complete finite lookup coverage.
Supply domain vocabulary without changing calculations.
State accepted premises and the applicability boundary.

caseInputs.description: Supply every declared parameter, including finite choice grids and current limits.
Supply typed records, accepted scenarios, calendars, grants, resources and other declared facts.
Record the accepted source and scope of supplied information.

responsibilities: Complete candidate assignments and all checked scenarios
Activities, interval/resource checks and scoped permission traces
Expense, timed cash events and peak cash where declared
reportResponsibilities.completeReportDocument: Unavailable for this pattern until milestone 5. Public assessment artifacts expose complete calculation data without claiming renderer-ready report support.

app.name: Plan the first shipment
app.description: Generate complete, static shipment plans from selectable lots, workers, preparation times, release time, carrier and departure. Check each whole plan against every declared readiness and travel scenario before comparing incremental expense. This synthetic operating snapshot does not infer readiness from business records or reserve stock, staff, authority or carrier capacity.
app.source:
# Canonical Decision Lab data. Rules are data, never executable code.
format: complete-a-commitment/1
module:
  id: plan-first-shipment
  title: Plan the first shipment
  description: "Generate complete, static shipment plans from selectable lots, workers, preparation times, release time, carrier and departure. Check each whole plan against every declared readiness and travel scenario before comparing incremental expense. This synthetic operating snapshot does not infer readiness from business records or reserve stock, staff, authority or carrier capacity."
  question: "Can we deliver the complete accepted order within its receipt, expense and cash limits?"
  template:
    id: complete-a-commitment
    version: 1
  units:
    time: synthetic day
    timeOrigin: Day 0 is the agreed start of the synthetic shipment-planning snapshot.
    money: hypothetical USD
    count: unit of resource capacity
    quantity: case
  assumptions: ["All firms, orders, lots, permissions, calendars, prices, holds and operating states are synthetic declarations.", "The accepted commitment fixes order revision, exact product revisions and quantities, recipient, prepaid terms, receipt window, deadline, expense limit and cash limit. A changed promise is a revised commitment.", "Each order line draws its entire quantity from one existing lot. Both selected lots must share one origin. Splits, transfers, production, replenishment and simultaneous multi-order allocation are outside this profile.", "The stock ledger, issued-grant registry, calendars, readiness declarations and carrier offerings remain stable over this planning horizon. Unlisted bookings and grants are absent from their stipulated complete registries.", Workers with the declared capabilities may pack or prepare the record at either site without travel or setup time. Record preparation is remote. The declared release officer may attend the sole release operation at either site. There are no other desk conflicts or equipment needs., "Tasks occupy half-open intervals. Packing and record preparation may proceed independently; both finish before final release, and final release finishes before departure.", "A service offering declares capacity available to the proposed booking; computing a passing plan does not create an external reservation or authorization.", Receipt occurs at arrival. Waiting or off-site staging to accommodate an early arrival is unsupported., "Worker and release charges occur at task starts; handling occurs at packing start; carrier fee and refundable hold occur at booking. The hold returns at arrival. Equal-time events are netted before each cash-balance check.", "Inventory is already owned. Acquisition costs, sales revenue, tax, penalties, borrowing, financing and customer receipts are excluded. Refundable holds affect cash in use and never incremental expense.", "Readiness states are supplied synthetic scoped declarations, not results of canonical evidence inference. No probability is attached to the explicitly listed joint scenarios.", "A single complete static plan is fixed before the scenario is known. Conditional plans, learning policies and new operating scenarios require a later supported capability."]
  inputs:
    parameters:
      owner:
        type: string
      launch:
        type: string
      snapshot:
        type: string
      order:
        type: string
      recipient:
        type: string
      terms:
        type: string
      skuA:
        type: string
      revisionA:
        type: string
      quantityA:
        type: integer
        unit: quantity
        minimum: 1
      skuB:
        type: string
      revisionB:
        type: string
      quantityB:
        type: integer
        unit: quantity
        minimum: 1
      deadline:
        type: number
        unit: time
        minimum: 0
      receiptOpen:
        type: number
        unit: time
        minimum: 0
      receiptClose:
        type: number
        unit: time
        minimum: 0
      expenseLimit:
        type: number
        unit: money
        minimum: 0
      cashLimit:
        type: number
        unit: money
        minimum: 0
      bookingTime:
        type: number
        unit: time
        minimum: 0
      releaseActor:
        type: string
        references:
          table: workers
          column: id
      packDuration:
        type: number
        unit: time
        exclusiveMinimum: 0
      recordDuration:
        type: number
        unit: time
        exclusiveMinimum: 0
      releaseDuration:
        type: number
        unit: time
        exclusiveMinimum: 0
      lotAChoices:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
          references:
            table: lots
            column: id
      lotBChoices:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
          references:
            table: lots
            column: id
      workerChoices:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
          references:
            table: workers
            column: id
      packStarts:
        type: array
        items:
          type: integer
          unit: time
          minimum: 0
      recordStarts:
        type: array
        items:
          type: integer
          unit: time
          minimum: 0
      releaseStarts:
        type: array
        items:
          type: integer
          unit: time
          minimum: 0
      departures:
        type: array
        items:
          type: integer
          unit: time
          minimum: 0
    tables:
      sites:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
          handlingFee:
            type: number
            unit: money
            minimum: 0
      lots:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
          sku:
            type: string
          revision:
            type: string
          origin:
            type: string
            references:
              table: sites
              column: id
          onHand:
            type: integer
            unit: quantity
            minimum: 0
          committed:
            type: integer
            unit: quantity
            minimum: 0
      workers:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
          fee:
            type: number
            unit: money
            minimum: 0
      capabilities:
        key: [actor, task]
        columns:
          actor:
            type: string
            references:
              table: workers
              column: id
          task:
            type: string
      calendars:
        key: [actor, start, end]
        columns:
          actor:
            type: string
            references:
              table: workers
              column: id
          start:
            type: number
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          end:
            type: number
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
      resources:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
          capacity:
            type: number
            unit: count
            minimum: 0
      bookings:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
          resource:
            type: string
            references:
              table: resources
              column: id
          start:
            type: number
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          end:
            type: number
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          amount:
            type: number
            unit: count
            minimum: 0
      grants:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
          actor:
            type: string
            references:
              table: workers
              column: id
          action:
            type: string
          origin:
            type: string
            references:
              table: sites
              column: id
          order:
            type: string
          recipient:
            type: string
          terms:
            type: string
          start:
            type: number
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
          end:
            type: number
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
      services:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
          fee:
            type: number
            unit: money
            minimum: 0
          hold:
            type: number
            unit: money
            minimum: 0
          capacity:
            type: integer
            unit: quantity
            minimum: 0
          bookingTime:
            type: number
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
      serviceOrigins:
        key: [service, origin]
        columns:
          service:
            type: string
            references:
              table: services
              column: id
          origin:
            type: string
            references:
              table: sites
              column: id
      serviceDepartures:
        key: [service, departure]
        columns:
          service:
            type: string
            references:
              table: services
              column: id
          departure:
            type: number
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
      conditions:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
      travel:
        key: [service, condition]
        columns:
          service:
            type: string
            references:
              table: services
              column: id
          condition:
            type: string
            references:
              table: conditions
              column: id
          duration:
            type: number
            unit: time
            minimum: 0
      readinessStates:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
      readiness:
        key: [state, origin]
        columns:
          state:
            type: string
            references:
              table: readinessStates
              column: id
          origin:
            type: string
            references:
              table: sites
              column: id
          order:
            type: string
          recipient:
            type: string
          snapshot:
            type: string
          registered:
            type: boolean
          itemsAligned:
            type: boolean
          ediReady:
            type: boolean
      scenarios:
        key: [id]
        columns:
          id:
            type: string
          readinessState:
            type: string
            references:
              table: readinessStates
              column: id
          condition:
            type: string
            references:
              table: conditions
              column: id
  choices:
    - id: lotA
      domain:
        parameter: lotAChoices
    - id: lotB
      domain:
        parameter: lotBChoices
    - id: packWorker
      domain:
        parameter: workerChoices
    - id: recordWorker
      domain:
        parameter: workerChoices
    - id: packStart
      domain:
        parameter: packStarts
    - id: recordStart
      domain:
        parameter: recordStarts
    - id: releaseStart
      domain:
        parameter: releaseStarts
    - id: service
      domain:
        table: services
        column: id
    - id: departure
      domain:
        parameter: departures
  scenarioDomain:
    table: scenarios
  lookupCoverage:
    - table: travel
      keys:
        service:
          domain:
            table: services
            column: id
        condition:
          domain:
            table: scenarios
            column: condition
    - table: readiness
      keys:
        state:
          domain:
            table: scenarios
            column: readinessState
        origin:
          domain:
            table: sites
            column: id
  derived:
    - id: origin
      type: string
      expr:
        op: lookup
        table: lots
        where:
          id:
            ref: choice.lotA
        column: origin
    - id: loadQuantity
      type: integer
      unit: quantity
      expr:
        op: add
        args:
          - ref: parameter.quantityA
          - ref: parameter.quantityB
    - id: arrival
      type: number
      unit: time
      expr:
        op: add
        args:
          - ref: choice.departure
          - op: lookup
            table: travel
            where:
              service:
                ref: choice.service
              condition:
                ref: scenario.condition
            column: duration
  activities:
    - id: pack
      actor:
        ref: choice.packWorker
      start:
        ref: choice.packStart
      duration:
        ref: parameter.packDuration
      resources:
        - resource:
            ref: choice.packWorker
          amount:
            literal: 1
        - resource:
            ref: derived.origin
          amount:
            literal: 1
    - id: record
      actor:
        ref: choice.recordWorker
      start:
        ref: choice.recordStart
      duration:
        ref: parameter.recordDuration
      resources:
        - resource:
            ref: choice.recordWorker
          amount:
            literal: 1
    - id: release
      actor:
        ref: parameter.releaseActor
      start:
        ref: choice.releaseStart
      duration:
        ref: parameter.releaseDuration
      resources:
        - resource:
            ref: parameter.releaseActor
          amount:
            literal: 1
  resources:
    definitions:
      table: resources
      idColumn: id
      capacityColumn: capacity
    bookings:
      table: bookings
      resourceColumn: resource
      startColumn: start
      endColumn: end
      amountColumn: amount
  requirements:
    - id: SUFFICIENCY
      label: Correct and ready load
      meaning: "The exact accepted product revisions and uncommitted quantities form one-origin load, and the selected origin and order satisfy the supplied scoped readiness declarations in every admitted state."
      waivable: false
    - id: RESOURCES
      label: Staff and dock availability
      meaning: "The same assigned actors have the declared capabilities and full-interval availability; their combined schedule and selected dock remain within resource capacity."
      waivable: false
    - id: TIME
      label: Task order and receipt deadline
      meaning: "Preparation precedes release, release precedes departure, and every modeled arrival meets the accepted latest receipt time."
      waivable: false
    - id: AUTHORITY
      label: Authorized release
      meaning: "An issued grant matches the actual actor, action, origin, order revision, recipient and terms and covers the whole release interval."
      waivable: false
    - id: ACCESS
      label: Carrier and recipient access
      meaning: "The offered service accepts the origin, load, booking time and departure; receipt occurs inside the recipient access window without unmodeled waiting."
      waivable: false
    - id: COST
      label: Incremental expense
      meaning: "Nonrefundable task, handling and carrier charges remain within the accepted expense limit."
      waivable: false
    - id: CASH
      label: Cash available before receipt
      meaning: "The maximum time-indexed cash in use, including refundable holds and net equal-time events, remains within available cash in every admitted scenario."
      waivable: false
  constraints:
    - id: SHIP-STOCK-A
      requirement: SUFFICIENCY
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: and
        args:
          - op: eq
            args:
              - op: lookup
                table: lots
                where:
                  id:
                    ref: choice.lotA
                column: sku
              - ref: parameter.skuA
          - op: eq
            args:
              - op: lookup
                table: lots
                where:
                  id:
                    ref: choice.lotA
                column: revision
              - ref: parameter.revisionA
          - op: gte
            args:
              - op: sub
                args:
                  - op: lookup
                    table: lots
                    where:
                      id:
                        ref: choice.lotA
                    column: onHand
                  - op: lookup
                    table: lots
                    where:
                      id:
                        ref: choice.lotA
                    column: committed
              - ref: parameter.quantityA
    - id: SHIP-STOCK-B
      requirement: SUFFICIENCY
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: and
        args:
          - op: eq
            args:
              - op: lookup
                table: lots
                where:
                  id:
                    ref: choice.lotB
                column: sku
              - ref: parameter.skuB
          - op: eq
            args:
              - op: lookup
                table: lots
                where:
                  id:
                    ref: choice.lotB
                column: revision
              - ref: parameter.revisionB
          - op: gte
            args:
              - op: sub
                args:
                  - op: lookup
                    table: lots
                    where:
                      id:
                        ref: choice.lotB
                    column: onHand
                  - op: lookup
                    table: lots
                    where:
                      id:
                        ref: choice.lotB
                    column: committed
              - ref: parameter.quantityB
    - id: SHIP-STOCK-ORIGIN
      requirement: SUFFICIENCY
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: eq
        args:
          - op: lookup
            table: lots
            where:
              id:
                ref: choice.lotB
            column: origin
          - ref: derived.origin
    - id: SHIP-READINESS
      requirement: SUFFICIENCY
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: and
        args:
          - op: eq
            args:
              - op: lookup
                table: readiness
                where:
                  state:
                    ref: scenario.readinessState
                  origin:
                    ref: derived.origin
                column: order
              - ref: parameter.order
          - op: eq
            args:
              - op: lookup
                table: readiness
                where:
                  state:
                    ref: scenario.readinessState
                  origin:
                    ref: derived.origin
                column: recipient
              - ref: parameter.recipient
          - op: eq
            args:
              - op: lookup
                table: readiness
                where:
                  state:
                    ref: scenario.readinessState
                  origin:
                    ref: derived.origin
                column: snapshot
              - ref: parameter.snapshot
          - op: eq
            args:
              - op: lookup
                table: readiness
                where:
                  state:
                    ref: scenario.readinessState
                  origin:
                    ref: derived.origin
                column: registered
              - literal: true
          - op: eq
            args:
              - op: lookup
                table: readiness
                where:
                  state:
                    ref: scenario.readinessState
                  origin:
                    ref: derived.origin
                column: itemsAligned
              - literal: true
          - op: eq
            args:
              - op: lookup
                table: readiness
                where:
                  state:
                    ref: scenario.readinessState
                  origin:
                    ref: derived.origin
                column: ediReady
              - literal: true
    - id: SHIP-WORK-PACK-CAPABILITY
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: capabilities
        where:
          actor:
            ref: choice.packWorker
          task:
            literal: pack
    - id: SHIP-WORK-RECORD-CAPABILITY
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: capabilities
        where:
          actor:
            ref: choice.recordWorker
          task:
            literal: record
    - id: SHIP-WORK-RELEASE-CAPABILITY
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: capabilities
        where:
          actor:
            ref: parameter.releaseActor
          task:
            literal: release
    - id: SHIP-WORK-PACK-WINDOW
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: interval-covered
        table: calendars
        where:
          actor:
            ref: choice.packWorker
        start:
          ref: activity.pack.start
        end:
          ref: activity.pack.end
        startColumn: start
        endColumn: end
    - id: SHIP-WORK-RECORD-WINDOW
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: interval-covered
        table: calendars
        where:
          actor:
            ref: choice.recordWorker
        start:
          ref: activity.record.start
        end:
          ref: activity.record.end
        startColumn: start
        endColumn: end
    - id: SHIP-WORK-RELEASE-WINDOW
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: interval-covered
        table: calendars
        where:
          actor:
            ref: parameter.releaseActor
        start:
          ref: activity.release.start
        end:
          ref: activity.release.end
        startColumn: start
        endColumn: end
    - id: SHIP-WORK-CAPACITY
      requirement: RESOURCES
      kind: resource-capacity
    - id: SHIP-PRE
      requirement: TIME
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: and
        args:
          - op: lte
            args:
              - ref: activity.pack.end
              - ref: activity.release.start
          - op: lte
            args:
              - ref: activity.record.end
              - ref: activity.release.start
          - op: lte
            args:
              - ref: activity.release.end
              - ref: choice.departure
    - id: SHIP-AUTH
      requirement: AUTHORITY
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: grants
        where:
          actor:
            ref: parameter.releaseActor
          action:
            literal: release
          origin:
            ref: derived.origin
          order:
            ref: parameter.order
          recipient:
            ref: parameter.recipient
          terms:
            ref: parameter.terms
        test:
          op: and
          args:
            - op: lte
              args:
                - ref: row.start
                - ref: activity.release.start
            - op: gte
              args:
                - ref: row.end
                - ref: activity.release.end
    - id: SHIP-SERVICE-ORIGIN
      requirement: ACCESS
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: serviceOrigins
        where:
          service:
            ref: choice.service
          origin:
            ref: derived.origin
    - id: SHIP-SERVICE-DEPARTURE
      requirement: ACCESS
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: exists
        table: serviceDepartures
        where:
          service:
            ref: choice.service
          departure:
            ref: choice.departure
    - id: SHIP-SERVICE-CAPACITY
      requirement: ACCESS
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: gte
        args:
          - op: lookup
            table: services
            where:
              id:
                ref: choice.service
            column: capacity
          - ref: derived.loadQuantity
    - id: SHIP-SERVICE-BOOKING
      requirement: ACCESS
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: and
        args:
          - op: eq
            args:
              - ref: parameter.bookingTime
              - op: lookup
                table: services
                where:
                  id:
                    ref: choice.service
                column: bookingTime
          - op: lte
            args:
              - ref: parameter.bookingTime
              - ref: choice.departure
    - id: SHIP-RECEIPT-WINDOW
      requirement: ACCESS
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: and
        args:
          - op: gte
            args:
              - ref: derived.arrival
              - ref: parameter.receiptOpen
          - op: lt
            args:
              - ref: derived.arrival
              - ref: parameter.receiptClose
    - id: SHIP-RECEIPT-DEADLINE
      requirement: TIME
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: lte
        args:
          - ref: derived.arrival
          - ref: parameter.deadline
    - id: SHIP-EXPENSE
      requirement: COST
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: lte
        args:
          - ref: finance.expense
          - ref: parameter.expenseLimit
    - id: SHIP-CASH
      requirement: CASH
      kind: predicate
      predicate:
        op: lte
        args:
          - ref: finance.peakCash
          - ref: parameter.cashLimit
  finance:

definitionContract.title: Complete a commitment
definitionContract.responsibility: Find one complete static operating choice that satisfies every mandatory obligation across every explicitly admitted joint scenario, then compare feasible choices.
invariants: Choices are finite, input-only controls. One complete assignment is shared across every admitted scenario and obligation.
Admitted joint scenarios are explicit facts; neither independence, probabilities nor unlisted scenarios are inferred.
An empty admitted basis is inconsistent, never a vacuous feasibility result.
Typed acyclic expressions separate static controls, scenario consequences and post-scenario preference aggregates.
Activities, calendars, bookings and permission validity use half-open intervals; adjacent intervals do not overlap.
Capacity is the sum of simultaneous renewable demands. A scoped grant must cover its entire required operation.
Expense sums nonrefundable charges. Refundable holds affect cash only; simultaneous cash events are netted before peak cash is measured.
Every mandatory condition must pass for the same choice in every admitted scenario. Preference cannot compensate for failure.
Ranking is lexicographic over feasible choices only; genuine ties are retained and identifiers only stabilize display order.
A fully checked witness establishes existence during partial search. No-plan and optimality claims require complete relevant coverage.
Missing data, unresolved lookups, unsafe arithmetic and unsupported declarations are invalid input, never invented facts.
Calculated feasibility is conditional on accepted facts and fixed assumptions, not permission, reservation or evidence of actual completion.

expressionLanguage.literals: Finite scalar or homogeneous scalar-array data; no executable code.

operators.add: At least two compatible numbers -> number
operators.mul: Two numbers with at most one dimensional operand -> number; count is a multiplicity
operators.lookup: Complete primary-key binding in a typed input table -> exactly one selected scalar; missing or ambiguous lookup is invalid
operators.exists: Typed equality bindings plus optional row-scoped predicate -> boolean; no match is false
operators.interval-covered: Typed selected calendar rows and a positive half-open interval -> boolean; adjacent coverage may combine
operators.worst-case: Numeric expression -> maximum across admitted scenarios for preference only; nested or unreduced scenario aggregates are invalid

module.title: Plan the first shipment
module.description: Generate complete, static shipment plans from selectable lots, workers, preparation times, release time, carrier and departure. Check each whole plan against every declared readiness and travel scenario before comparing incremental expense. This synthetic operating snapshot does not infer readiness from business records or reserve stock, staff, authority or carrier capacity.
module.question: Can we deliver the complete accepted order within its receipt, expense and cash limits?

units.timeOrigin: Day 0 is the agreed start of the synthetic shipment-planning snapshot.

assumptions: All firms, orders, lots, permissions, calendars, prices, holds and operating states are synthetic declarations.

The accepted commitment fixes order revision, exact product revisions and quantities, recipient, prepaid terms, receipt window, deadline, expense limit and cash limit. A changed promise is a revised commitment.

Each order line draws its entire quantity from one existing lot. Both selected lots must share one origin. Splits, transfers, production, replenishment and simultaneous multi-order allocation are outside this profile.

The stock ledger, issued-grant registry, calendars, readiness declarations and carrier offerings remain stable over this planning horizon. Unlisted bookings and grants are absent from their stipulated complete registries.

Workers with the declared capabilities may pack or prepare the record at either site without travel or setup time. Record preparation is remote. The declared release officer may attend the sole release operation at either site. There are no other desk conflicts or equipment needs.
Tasks occupy half-open intervals. Packing and record preparation may proceed independently; both finish before final release, and final release finishes before departure.
A service offering declares capacity available to the proposed booking; computing a passing plan does not create an external reservation or authorization.
Receipt occurs at arrival. Waiting or off-site staging to accommodate an early arrival is unsupported.

Worker and release charges occur at task starts; handling occurs at packing start; carrier fee and refundable hold occur at booking. The hold returns at arrival. Equal-time events are netted before each cash-balance check.

Inventory is already owned. Acquisition costs, sales revenue, tax, penalties, borrowing, financing and customer receipts are excluded. Refundable holds affect cash in use and never incremental expense.
Readiness states are supplied synthetic scoped declarations, not results of canonical evidence inference. No probability is attached to the explicitly listed joint scenarios.
A single complete static plan is fixed before the scenario is known. Conditional plans, learning policies and new operating scenarios require a later supported capability.

requirements.label: Correct and ready load
requirements.meaning: The exact accepted product revisions and uncommitted quantities form one-origin load, and the selected origin and order satisfy the supplied scoped readiness declarations in every admitted state.

requirements.label: Staff and dock availability
requirements.meaning: The same assigned actors have the declared capabilities and full-interval availability; their combined schedule and selected dock remain within resource capacity.

requirements.label: Task order and receipt deadline
requirements.meaning: Preparation precedes release, release precedes departure, and every modeled arrival meets the accepted latest receipt time.

requirements.label: Authorized release
requirements.meaning: An issued grant matches the actual actor, action, origin, order revision, recipient and terms and covers the whole release interval.

requirements.label: Carrier and recipient access
requirements.meaning: The offered service accepts the origin, load, booking time and departure; receipt occurs inside the recipient access window without unmodeled waiting.

requirements.label: Incremental expense
requirements.meaning: Nonrefundable task, handling and carrier charges remain within the accepted expense limit.

requirements.label: Cash available before receipt
requirements.meaning: The maximum time-indexed cash in use, including refundable holds and net equal-time events, remains within available cash in every admitted scenario.
